sections.title: # The Alumni Of TKRCET
content: established in 2008 and registered under ID 322/2008

The Alumni Of TKRCET, Established In 2008 And Registered Under ID 322/2008, Have Quickly Proven Themselves To Be Capable Engineers, Scientists, And Professionals. Their Achievements Have Helped Establish A Positive Image For Their Alma Mater As A Distinguished Educational Institution. Upon Graduating From TKRCET, Students Embark On Their Professional Journeys, Where Higher Education Plays A Crucial Role In Their Career Development. Our Alumni Have Consistently Demonstrated Excellence From The Outset, Maintaining Personal Connections With One Another That Go Beyond The Formal Channels Of The Alumni Association. For TKRCET, A Special Bond Is Formed When Students Complete Their Studies And Move Forward Into Their Careers. Witnessing Our Graduates Excel And Make Significant Contributions In Their Fields Fills Us With Immense Pride And Joy—An Indescribable Feeling That Reflects The Strength And Spirit Of Our Institution.
